operational.description: Repository availability and observable default-branch automation health.

governance.description: Portfolio review, status-declaration, lifecycle, and repository identity governance checks.

assurance.description: Repository-specific assurance evidence coverage, execution state, provenance and freshness against governed repository revisions.

cross_specification.description: Cross-specification pressure-test evidence is not yet ingested as a portfolio-wide assurance dimension.

findings.subject: governance-authority-assurance-metamodel
findings.claim: A governed active or review repository is no longer present in public account discovery; its registry identity may be stale.
findings.recommended_action: Determine whether the repository was renamed, transferred, privatized, deleted, or intentionally retired, then update the governed repository identity and relationships. Do not infer the new identity automatically.

remediation.objective: Reconcile the governed repository identity with the repository's actual rename, transfer, visibility, deletion, or retirement state.
acceptance_criteria: The governed registry points to the intended current repository identity, or the repository lifecycle/disposition records intentional retirement.
No automatic identity inference is used as closure evidence.
verification: Run public-account discovery and portfolio validation.

handoff.closure_rule: A finding is closed only when a later monitor run no longer observes the condition and records closure evidence in the lifecycle registry.
